subject: Request: CobaltBridge combined credits + discount (exec approval)
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@cobaltbridge.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@cobaltbridge.com
Date: 2028-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: trial extension + credits + initial discount

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at CobaltBridge is excited about Redwood's latency and cost numbers. Procurement asked me to surface one consolidated ask so we can move to an internal PO quickly:

- 90-day trial extension (their security and compliance review runs through late Q3)
- $50,000 in free inference credits to cover evaluation traffic during the POC
- 25% first-year discount on the initial committed tier if we sign within 60 days

They've attached a draft PO with the timeline. Procurement is targeting a legal/finance approval window that closes on 2028-06-15, so any exceptional approvals will help speed things.

Why this matters: CobaltBridge is a vertical SaaS provider with demonstrable expansion potential across three product lines; if the POC shows parity on throughput and cost, they are likely to convert to a 12-mo committed contract within 9 months.

Attached: CobaltBridge_PO_draft.pdf

Can you advise on what concessions are possible and how fast we can get internal exec sign-off?

Best,
Alex Turner
Enterprise Account Lead
CobaltBridge

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@cobaltbridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: trial extension + credits + initial discount

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the PO. I copied Marissa and Ben for visibility. Quick read: procurement timeline is tight but we can escalate.

Internal constraints to flag: per our policy, any credit top-up > $40k OR discount > 20% needs executive approval. I'll put together a recommendation and a short ROI memorandum for the approval thread.

Proposed immediate next steps (mutual action plan):
1) I prepare an internal request (ask: 50k credits + 20% discount + 60-day extension) and route to Sales VP for approval (Markus).
2) Alex confirms target commitment (if they sign 12 months at >$180k ARR we can be flexible on credits).
3) Legal/Procurement: we get PO in draft form + DPAs completed; I will loop Legal if approval obtained.

Alex — can you confirm whether CobaltBridge can commit to a 12-month $180k minimum ARR if the POC meets performance goals? That commitment materially affects what we can approve. If yes, I will recommend we approve the full credit request.

I'm attaching an anonymized usage snapshot they shared so Markus has data to review quickly.

Attached: trial_usage_report.csv

Thanks — will escalate this today.

— Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-02T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Exec approval request: CobaltBridge concession recommendation

Markus — looping you in for an expedited sign-off. Summary: CobaltBridge (strategic mid-market vertical) requests 90-day extension + $50k credits + 25% first-year discount. Procurement deadline 6/15.

Recommendation (to minimize precedent while enabling conversion):
- Approve $35k in free inference credits (usable during POC, expires 90 days after activation)
- Approve 20% first-year discount tied to a 12-month minimum commit (suggest $180k ARR floor)
- Approve a 60-day trial extension (instead of full 90) to limit runway while still covering compliance testing

Rationale: $35k credit + 20% discount gives procurement momentum while keeping uplift within current concession bands. CobaltBridge shows high expansion velocity in our comps; with a 12-mo commit we can recover unit economics.

Risks/notes:
- This is above the normal credit threshold; recommend tagging as a single-account carveout and documenting in approval_matrix.xlsx (attached).
- Require PO signed by 2028-06-10 and DPA signed before credits are issued.

If approved, I will draft the conditional concession language for Legal and send a DocuSign for signature. Need a quick yes/no by end of day 2028-06-03 to meet procurement cadence.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai

Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-03T15:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval request: CobaltBridge concession recommendation

Approved with conditions.

Approval details:
- Free credits: $35,000 (one-time top-up).
- Trial extension: 60 days added to current trial window (credits valid only during trial period).
- Discount: 20% off first-year list price contingent on a signed 12-month commitment at a minimum ARR of $180,000.
- Timing: PO must be received by 2028-06-10 and DPA signed before credits are issued.

Conditions / follow-ups:
1) Add a clause to the concession memo: credits are non-refundable and expire after 90 days from issuance if not used. (Legal to finalize language.)
2) Finance to record the concession in the approval_matrix.xlsx under DEAL-2028-0472.
3) Sales to confirm expected MRR uplift and include the commitment in HubSpot (link below).

Marissa/ Priyom — proceed to prepare the conditional concession language and DocuSign envelope. Once procurement returns the PO and DPA, release credits programmatically from the grants pipeline.

Approved — MK
Markus Klein
VP, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
